// @path: src/app/ops/page.tsx
// @expect: OPS-REQUIRE-OPERATOR
// The leak the door widening could have introduced, and the reason the narrow
// guard is allowed in two named files and nowhere else: requireOpsDoor() proves
// only that the area is switched on. A console page opening with it renders for
// anybody who asks.
import { requireOpsDoor } from "@/lib/ops/session";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

export default async function OpsConsolePage() {
  await requireOpsDoor();
  return <main><h1>Operations</h1></main>;
}
